Traditional temple-food practices generally exclude pungent vegetables-such as garlic, green onion, chives, wild garlic, and asafoetida-and incorporate a variety of plant-based ingredients and fermented foods, such as fermented soybean paste (doenjang), soy sauce (ganjang), fermented red chili paste (gochujang), fermented soybean paste (cheonggukjang), and fermented vegetables (kimchi).

berichten.titel: Improved long-term proliferation and myogenic differentiation of bovine muscle stem cells through CDKN2A gene editing
berichten.samenvatting: The production of cultured meat is constrained by the limited proliferation and differentiation capacity of seed cells. Here, we report that prolonged in vitro culture induces cellular senescence in bovine muscle stem cells (bMuSCs), impairing their proliferative and myogenic potential. We then examined the expression of cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors (CKIs) and found that CDKN2A expression was markedly upregulated during passaging and its knockout substantially enhanced the expansion of bMuSCs.

berichten.titel: Evidence Suggests Linoleic Acid Exerts Health Benefits Beyond Cardiovascular Disease: A Brief Review of Clinical and Observational Studies
berichten.samenvatting: Questions challenging the healthfulness of diets high in linoleic acid (LA) and seed oils, which are major sources of this essential fatty acid, have recently arisen. These questions are especially relevant to adherents of plant-based diets as their LA intake is higher than the general population. Some maintain that LA increases inflammation and oxidative stress and for these reasons, despite its ability to lower circulating LDL-cholesterol levels when replacing saturated fat, does not lower cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk.

berichten.titel: Phytase-loaded core-shell microparticles for enzyme stabilization using ethanol anti-solvent precipitation
berichten.samenvatting: In plant-based diets, phytate reduces the adsorption of minerals. Fortifying foods with phytase can improve mineral bioavailability by hydrolyzing phytate. However, phytase is susceptible to environmental stress such as heat and acidic conditions encountered during food processing. A core-shell microparticle composed of a phytase-chitosan core and a shell consisting of cross-linked alginate-κ-carrageenan was developed using ethanol anti-solvent precipitation.

berichten.titel: Application of dual-marker DNA metabarcoding to verify label accuracy in plant-based protein foods
berichten.samenvatting: The global market for plant-based protein foods is rapidly expanding; however, complex supply chains and multi-step processing pose substantial traceability challenges. This study applied DNA metabarcoding to identify plant-derived ingredients in plant-based protein foods, involving the amplification and sequencing of short DNA marker fragments. To enhance the efficiency of species detection, a dual-marker approach using ITS2 and trnL(UAA) was applied to analyze a mock mixed library containing 37 confirmed species.

berichten.titel: Potential Biodiversity Footprint Reductions from Intended Shifts to Plant-Based Meals
berichten.samenvatting: Adopting plant-based diets can mitigate biodiversity loss by reducing the demand for land required for feed and livestock. Yet, most assessments rely on hypothetical dietary scenarios that potentially overestimate biodiversity gains. We conducted a large-scale consumer survey across three countries (NLD, GBR, and USA) and estimated the biodiversity footprints of current and intended future diets using the loss of mean species abundance (MSA-loss) and the loss of global species richness (RSR-loss) as indicators.

berichten.titel: Integrated Transcriptomic-Proteomic Profiling Identifies Candidate Regulators of Stemness Maintenance in Skeletal Muscle Satellite Cells
berichten.samenvatting: Cultured meat is recognized as a sustainable alternative to animal products, but the gradual stemness loss in seed cells during in vitro culture remains a challenge for industrialization. Here, we isolated chicken embryonic skeletal muscle satellite cells and observed a pronounced decline in stemness following the third passage.

berichten.titel: QUALITY OF PROTEIN IN DIFFERENT FOOD SOURCES IN THE CONTEXT OF CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE
berichten.samenvatting: Plant-based diets have gained increasing attention in the management of chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet concerns persist regarding the quality of plant-derived proteins. Traditionally, animal-based proteins have been regarded as high biological value proteins, while plant proteins have been labeled as low biological value, contributing to misconceptions about their nutritional adequacy.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of renal nutrition : the official journal of the Council on Renal Nutrition of the National Kidney Foundation

berichten.titel: From bioreactor to table: reinventing future protein supply through cellular agriculture
berichten.samenvatting: Confronted with the severe environmental pressures, resource constraints, and ethical concerns of conventional animal husbandry, cellular agriculture has emerged as a revolutionary paradigm aiming to reshape the global food supply chain by producing meat, dairy, and eggs directly in controlled environments. This review systematically examines the two core pathways of this field, cell-cultured meat and precision fermentation, by outlining their technological advancements, industrialization challenges, and future prospects.

berichten.titel: Synthesis and Characterization of Naringin Phenolate Salts for Cultivated Meat
berichten.samenvatting: The high cost of growth factors has limited the commercial-scale production of cultivated meat products. In this study, we report on the synthesis and characterization of a series of naringin phenolate salts. Phenolate salts with sodium (Na+), potassium (K+), calcium (Ca2+), and tetrabutylammonium (TBA+) counterions were prepared to introduce water solubility to the natural flavonoid naringin. The synthesized salts were comprehensively characterized to confirm their chemical structures. Solvated cations were examined for their effect on the salts' physicochemical and biological properties.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

berichten.titel: Plant Protein-Based Scaffolds for Cultivated Meat Production: A Review
berichten.samenvatting: This review summarises recent progress in the development of plant protein-based scaffolds for cultivated meat production, with a particular focus on protein sources derived from major agricultural crops and their processing into functional biomaterials. We discuss how protein extraction strategies, as well as emerging technologies, influence protein purity, functionality and suitability for scaffold fabrication.

berichten.titel: Vitamin B12 Biofortification in Edible Plants: Opportunities and Limitations from Soil-Based to Controlled Cultivation Systems
berichten.samenvatting: Vitamin B12 is largely absent from edible plants, increasing the risk of deficiency as plant-based diets became more prevalent worldwide. This review summarizes current strategies for vitamin B12 biofortification in plants, including the use of organic fertilizers, biofertilizers, hydroponics, aeroponics, foliar applications, and seed-based approaches. It also examines soil dynamics, microbial interactions, and other factors that influence vitamin B12 uptake and accumulation.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

berichten.titel: Efficacy of yeast mannan supplementation on increasing stool frequency in adults: a randomized controlled trial
berichten.samenvatting: Yeast mannans are microbial-available substrates that may improve laxation and specifically modulate gut microbiota composition.
